citation: Vloemans et al. (2024), Lab on a Chip, Fig. 4A–B
observable: Measured free fluorescein concentrations in successive 10 microliter plugs. Compare concentrations on the same assay scale within each series.
uncertainty: Printed means, at least three replicates per point. Error bars show one SD. Absolute SDs were not transcribed. Wall adsorption and instrument range can contribute to deviations.
